## Contributor consent

**Required for every contribution from anyone other than the copyright holder.**
A pull request alone does not record consent, and a pull request without the
statement below is not merged.

Post this as a comment on this pull request, filling in your name or GitHub
handle and the date:

> I have read and agree to the VOLDBASE Contribution Terms in `LICENSE`
> section 8 for the contributions in this pull request. I confirm that:
>
> - I am the author of these contributions, or I have the right to submit them;
> - I hold the rights needed to grant the licence in `LICENSE` section 8.4 for
>   the whole contribution, or the person or organisation that holds those
>   rights has authorised me to grant that licence on these terms, and that
>   authority is identified in this comment;
> - any third-party material in the contribution is identified, is properly
>   licensed, and its licence permits the grant in `LICENSE` section 8.4; and
> - I understand that I keep any copyright I hold, and that nothing in this
>   statement assigns copyright.
>
> Signed: _your name or GitHub handle_, _date (YYYY-MM-DD)_

If you do not hold copyright in the contribution (for example, because your
employer, client or another organisation does), identify the rights holder and
the authority you have to submit it in the same comment. Do not claim copyright
you do not hold.

If you are contributing on behalf of an organisation, or the contribution is
owned or controlled by your employer, client or another organisation, that
organisation must either authorise you in that comment to grant the `LICENSE`
section 8.4 licence, or agree separate written terms with the copyright holder.

## Maintainer check

- [ ] A consent statement from the contributor is recorded on this pull request
      (link it here), or the contribution is by the copyright holder.
- [ ] The statement has not been edited or supplied on the contributor's behalf.
